# Multishop: cache_default_attribute is not reset for all shops when changing a product with combinations to a standard product

In a multishop context, when a product has combinations, PrestaShop stores the default combination ID in the `cache_default_attribute` field of the `product_shop` table.

If the product type is later changed from a product with combinations to **Standard product**, the `cache_default_attribute` value is reset to `0` only for the default shop.

Rows related to the other shops keep the previous default combination ID. This leaves inconsistent data in `product_shop` and can trigger a front-office error on the product page.

Error:

```text
Deprecated: round(): Passing null to parameter #1 ($num) of type int|float is deprecated in D:\cms\Prestashop\_Github\PrestaShop-dev-9.1\classes\Tools.php on line 1618
```

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/610d4be6-9225-4ad6-bcde-e6e78bdb3942

## Étapes
1. Enable multishop.
2. Create at least two shops.
3. Create a product assigned to both shops.
4. Set the product type to a product with combinations.
5. Create one or more combinations.
6. Set one combination as the default combination.
7. Check the `product_shop` table.
8. Verify that `cache_default_attribute` is populated with the default combination ID for the product shop rows.
9. Edit the product.
10. Change the product type to **Standard product**.
11. Save the product.
12. Check the `product_shop` table again.
13. Notice that `cache_default_attribute` is set to `0` only for the default shop, while the other shop rows still contain the old combination ID.
14. Open the product page in the front office for the affected shop.
